batch: Exodus Block 4 - The Golden Calf & the Covenant Renewed (Ex 32:1-34:35), passages cast by scene / operation-web. Narrative-rich; multi-interior (Israel, Aaron, Moses, God).

units.characteristics: the people's impatience; the calf fashioned; 'these are your gods'
units.gist: NARRATIVE/GEM - Moses delays on the mountain; the people GATHER against Aaron - 'make us GODS to go before us, for this Moses we do not know what became of him'; Aaron takes their gold, fashions a molten CALF - 'these are your gods, O Israel, who brought you out of Egypt'; builds an altar, PROCLAIMS (qara 32:5) a feast to the LORD; they rise up to play. The impatient interior that will not wait, that must SEE a god - the vow 'we will do' (24:7) breaking within days.

units.characteristics: God's burning anger; the stiff-necked people; Moses' first intercession; the LORD relents
units.gist: NARRATIVE/GEM - the LORD to Moses: 'go down, YOUR people have corrupted themselves'; 'I have seen this people, a STIFF-NECKED (qasheh 32:9) people; let my WRATH (charah 32:10) BURN against them that I may consume them, and I will make of YOU a great nation'; Moses INTERCEDES - appeals to God's reputation before Egypt ('why should the Egyptians say...'), to the RAM/harm (ra 32:12), and to the oath to Abraham/Isaac/Israel (REMEMBER zakhar 32:13); and the LORD RELENTED (naham 32:14) from the harm. The mediator turning back wrath by appeal to God's name and covenant; God who RELENTS.

units.characteristics: Moses' anger; the tablets broken; Aaron's excuse; the Levites' costly loyalty
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Moses descends, hears the singing; his ANGER (charah 32:19) burns, he THROWS the tablets and breaks them; burns the calf, grinds it, makes them drink; confronts Aaron - 'what did this people do to you that you brought a great SIN (chata) on them?'; Aaron's EXCUSE - 'I threw the gold in the fire and out came this calf' (the evasion); the people RUNNING WILD (para 32:25, a DERISION/shame shim among enemies); Moses - 'who is on the LORD's side?'; the Levites gather, kill 3000; 'you have ORDAINED yourselves today'. Moses' righteous anger vs Aaron's evasion; costly loyalty.

units.characteristics: the second intercession; 'blot me out'; the people mourn; 'I will not go up among you'
units.gist: NARRATIVE/GEM - Moses returns to the LORD - 'this people has sinned a great SIN; but now, if you will forgive their sin - and if not, BLOT ME OUT (machah) of your book that you have written' (the mediator offering himself); the LORD - 'whoever has SINNED (chata) I will blot out'; sends a PLAGUE; then 'go, lead the people... but I will NOT GO UP among you, lest I consume you, for you are STIFF-NECKED (qasheh 33:5)'; the people MOURN (abal 33:4), strip off their ornaments (sur 33:6). The mediator offering his own life; the terrible word 'I will not go with you'.

units.characteristics: the tent of meeting; 'if your presence does not go'; 'show me your glory'
units.gist: NARRATIVE/GEM - Moses pitches the tent of meeting outside the camp; the LORD speaks to him face to face as a friend; Moses PLEADS - God says I know you by name and you have found FAVOR (chen 33:12,17); Moses asks to be shown God's ways, and pleads consider this nation is YOUR people; the LORD - my PRESENCE will go with you, and I will give you REST (nuach 33:14); Moses - if your presence does not go, do not bring us up; how shall it be known we have found favor unless you go with us?; then Moses asks to be shown God's GLORY (kavod 33:18) - the LORD will make his goodness pass, will be GRACIOUS (chanan 33:19) to whom he will be gracious, have COMPASSION (racham) on whom he will, but Moses cannot see God's FACE and live; hidden in the cleft, shown God's back. The mediator staking everything on the PRESENCE; the longing to SEE God.

units.characteristics: the new tablets; the LORD proclaims his Name - compassionate and gracious
units.gist: GEM - Moses cuts two new tablets, ascends; the LORD descends in the cloud and PROCLAIMS (qara 34:5,6) the NAME - 'The LORD, the LORD, a God COMPASSIONATE (racham 34:6) and GRACIOUS (channun), slow to anger, abounding in STEADFAST LOVE (chesed) and FAITHFULNESS (emet), keeping steadfast love for thousands, FORGIVING (nasa/salach) INIQUITY (avon) and TRANSGRESSION (pesha) and SIN (chata), but who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting iniquity to the third and fourth generation'; Moses bows, worships - 'if I have found FAVOR (chen 34:9)... pardon (salach) our iniquity and sin, and take us as your inheritance'. THE great self-revelation of God's character (the channun of 22:27 fully sounded); the mediator pleading the Name he has just heard.

units.characteristics: the covenant renewed; jealous God, no other gods; Moses' shining face
units.gist: NARRATIVE/GEM - the LORD CUTS (karat 34:10,27) the COVENANT (berit) anew, promises WONDERS (pala 34:10); warns against covenant with the land's peoples lest it be a snare - for the LORD is JEALOUS (qanna 34:14); do not WHORE (zanah 34:15,16) after their gods; the feasts, the firstborn REDEEMED (padah 34:20), the sabbath rest, 'none shall COVET (chamad 34:24) your land' when you go up; Moses forty days, writes the Ten Words; comes down, his FACE SHINES (from speaking with God) and the people are AFRAID (yare 34:30) to come near; he veils his face. The covenant remade after the breach; the mediator radiant from the presence.
